title: Calibration
description: Fitted conformal threshold q_hat and NO_FAULT threshold tau_nf for one calibration family id, with hashes of the split, scores and config they came from; no per-case labels or case ids. Written by bench as canonical_json(content) + LF, read by Causentra through ctx.config.calibration.

family.description: The file's 4-part family id (equal to the file stem); its ai_arm, alert_protocol and fold segments equal the fields below (loader check).

ai_arm.description: The file applies only to runs with this AI arm; a mismatch is a hard error (03 §12.1, 09 §3.15).

alert_protocol.description: The file applies only to runs with this alert protocol; a mismatch is a hard error (03 §12.1, 09 §3.15).

rank_index.description: ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha)); may exceed n, in which case q_hat is null (+inf) (09 §3.7, contract_changes B).

q_hat.description: The rank_index-th smallest calibration score; null means +inf.

no_fault.description: NO_FAULT threshold fit over normal windows of the calibration split (09 §3.8).

beta.description: Target false-alarm level beta on normal windows.

rank_index.description: ceil((m + 1)(1 - beta)); may exceed m, in which case tau_nf is the default and calibrated is false.

tau_nf.description: The rank_index-th smallest statistic M, or no_fault.default_tau (log1p(3.0)) when not fitted.

calibrated.description: false when tau_nf is the default because rank_index > m.

sources.description: Normal-window sources used, a subset of the three listed (03 §12.1).

split.description: Which calibration cases were used, as a hash only (03 §12.1).

seed.description: Seed of the cluster split (04 §5.4 split.seed).

fold.description: Calibration fold, equal to the family id's last segment, e.g. foldA.

scores_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical calibration scores; +inf scores are hashed as null (contract_changes B).

code_commit.description: Code commit of the calibration runs, as in run_manifest ("<sha>+dirty.<12 hex>" for a dirty tree).

experiment_id.description: Bench experiment that fitted the file (bench/experiments/<experiment_id>.yaml).

family_id.description: Calibration family id <benchmark family>.<ai_arm>.<alert_protocol>.<fold>, always four dot-separated parts (03 §12.1, contract_changes B). The per-system (Mondrian) variant puts the system into the first part (<family>-<system>, e.g. rcaeval-re2-ob.brief.oracle.foldA); the leave-one-system-out variant puts it into the fold part (loso-<system>, e.g. rcaeval-re2.brief.oracle.loso-ob). Used by calibration.family, verdict.calibration.family and config_lock.calibration.family_id.
